method: sequential contact-sheet inspection of every exported frame; no claim of animated GIF playback
notes: Reference identity, curly auburn hair, sunglasses, white blouse, brown wide trousers, jewelry and sneakers remain recognizable.
All attacks have readable guard/windup/extension/recovery or brace progression. No clear missing/extra limbs observed.
Air attacks and middle jump phases show tucked feet; grounded crouches and landing have support feet.
Turn progresses through visible front torso from right to left; final KO is horizontal with complete body.
Head-based scales replace source-row-height scales; values are approximate manual estimates.
Replacement locomotion passes sequential pose review: coherent foot phases, anatomically plausible support, near-matching endpoints. Harmless 2D trouser overlap is not treated as broken anatomy.
